description: SRUP - Albufeiras de Águas Públicas Classificadas is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Direção-Geral do Território. Public Utility Servitude and Restriction (SRUP) - Classified Public Water Reservoirs, in force in mainland Portugal. The Classified Public Water Reservoirs are a servitude and restriction of public utility. Coverage: Direção-Geral do Território. The portal shows the English title as "SRUP - Classified Public Water Reservoirs" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Direção-Geral do Território. Its keywords include em-vigor, planeamento-e-cadastro, cartografia-oficial, srup, infomapaccessservice, nacional. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
